researchDecision.method: Smoothed bounded clearance with a five-ring tapered yoke, fitted sleeves, shallow saddle and compact rear-neck hood surface
researchDecision.finding: The v29 representation reduced total intersections and eliminated measured hood intersections, but it removed the visible high-cut underbody connection and still fails the product silhouette and dynamic sleeve fit.

blockingFindings.finding: The front, rear and three-quarter views show a long top ending over the hips; the garment no longer presents a connected high-cut bodysuit bridge or leg openings.
The five-ring yoke reads as a broad flat plate around the neck and upper back instead of a fitted neckline integrated into the garment.
Side views retain abrupt folds and protrusions where the sleeves meet the torso.
All six required poses still fail the evaluated-mesh BVH audit, with the largest counts in arms-up (3676) and prone (3120).
The sleeve profile is visually slimmer than v28, but the left and right sleeves still contribute 5293 overlap pairs across the required poses.
Measured hood intersections are zero, but the rear-neck surface reads primarily as a wide collar flap rather than a coherent wearable hood.

nextAction: Restore an explicit continuous high-cut underbody and leg-opening topology, then rebuild the neck/hood transition without a plate-like yoke. Reduce dynamic sleeve intersections before another visual review.
